samples.description: Annual Compustat firm-year records for fiscal years 1974–2005 with current-year source-screen indicators and one- and two-year-ahead outcomes. Current and future earnings use unique GVKEY/FYEAR source periods from fiscal years 1973–2007; current-year screens do not filter prior assets or future earnings. A lagged-assets input is retained from a duplicate fiscal-year key only when exactly one source row has positive observed AT and a positive own-date USD conversion. Earnings require observed provider-mapped IDIT (legacy item #62) and other source inputs; no missing interest value is imputed. One record per GVKEY and fiscal year.

assumptions: Country eligibility uses annual-row FUNDA.FIC, labeled current; the authorized catalog has no dated incorporation history.

Industry uses valid FUNDA.SICH first, then one unique date-valid CCM-linked CRSP MSENAMES.SICCD only when SICH is missing/zero; valid SICH controls disagreements. SIC 6000–6999 is financial and 4900–4999 is utility as a disclosed best-effort convention because the paper does not state code boundaries.

The source item #62 interest-income input is modern Compustat Xpressfeed IDIT, verified in the 2007 provider guide (physical p.18, printed p.12). Only observed IDIT is used; missing IDIT is not set to zero and NOPI−NOPIO is not used as a substitute. This complete-case input restriction may lower N relative to the paper.
Both current and future adjusted earnings use the same positive AT(t−1) denominator after own-date currency conversion; fixed [−1,1] winsorization is applied to the rates.
Two-way firm and fiscal-year clustered OLS uses installed reghdfe with no absorbed effects and retains the intercept.

Current and future earnings use only unique GVKEY/FYEAR periods. A lagged-assets value from a duplicate fiscal-year key is used only when exactly one row has observed positive AT and a positive own-date USD conversion; all four duplicate-period rows lack IDIT, so no duplicate-key earnings value is imputed or used.

limitations: FUNDA.FIC is labeled Current ISO Country Code – Incorporation; no dated incorporation-history table is available in the authorized catalog, so the historic U.S.-incorporation screen has a timing limitation.

The 2007 Compustat Xpressfeed guide maps modern IDIT to Interest Income, the source construct at legacy item #62. Missing IDIT is left unavailable; the paper gives no separate missing-item policy. No zero-fill or NOPI−NOPIO fallback is used, so the observed-IDIT complete-case restriction may reduce the Table 4 sample.

FUNDA.SICH is used when it contains a valid historical code; otherwise the screen uses one unique dated CRSP MSENAMES.SICCD from a date-valid CCM link. The paper does not specify numeric SIC cutoffs; the implementation uses the conventional 6000–6999 financial and 4900–4999 utility ranges. Overlap disagreements and unresolved rows are reported, with SICH primary.

Two GVKEY/FYEAR source keys have multiple annual rows (four records for one GVKEY across two fiscal years); all four lack IDIT. Ambiguous source periods are not selected arbitrarily and cannot supply current, lagged-asset, or future inputs. The handoff retains only unique annual periods.

FUNDA does not contain IDIT_DC in the authorized annual extract, so provider combined-item status cannot be separately audited row by row. The build uses only the provider-mapped observed IDIT value and does not derive missing values from other aggregates.
The date-valid CRSP listing screen uses common share codes 10/11 with NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ exchange codes 1/2/3 as a best-effort interpretation of the paper’s listing criterion.
